description: This file contains functions and type definitions related to configuring and migrating Matrix accounts and credentials within the openclaw project, including loading stored credentials, resolving configuration fields, and handling legacy storage targets.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string or returns an empty string if input is not a string.

methods.name: resolveMatrixStringSourceValue
methods.description: Returns the string value if input is a string, otherwise returns an empty string.

methods.name: shouldAllowBaseAuthFallback
methods.description: Determines if fallback to base authentication fields is allowed based on account ID and field.

methods.name: resolveMatrixAccountStringValues
methods.description: Resolves various Matrix account string fields from multiple sources including account data, environment variables, and channel configuration.

methods.name: resolveScopedMatrixEnvConfig
methods.description: Resolves scoped environment variables for a specific Matrix account ID.

methods.name: resolveGlobalMatrixEnvConfig
methods.description: Resolves global environment variables for Matrix configuration.

methods.name: resolveMatrixAccountConfigEntry
methods.description: Retrieves Matrix account configuration entry from the main config.

methods.name: resolveMatrixFlatStoreSelectionNote
methods.description: Generates a note about legacy Matrix flat store migration based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveMatrixMigrationConfigFields
methods.description: Resolves the homeserver, userId, and accessToken fields for Matrix migration based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: loadStoredMatrixCredentials
methods.description: Loads stored Matrix credentials from disk based on environment and account ID.

methods.name: credentialsMatchResolvedIdentity
methods.description: Checks if stored credentials match a given identity (homeserver, userId, accessToken).

methods.name: resolveMatrixMigrationAccountTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target account information for Matrix migration, including credentials and storage root.

methods.name: resolveLegacyMatrixFlatStoreTarget
methods.description: Resolves or warns about legacy Matrix flat store targets based on configuration and detected path.
